records.trigger: The INIT_CHECK gate decides on agentResults and issues, but signInitCheck takes neither as input, so a hand-edited init-check.json stays signature-valid and the gate accepts it with zero init_check_set calls.
records.observedFailure: 5 RED / 0 BROKEN, exit 1. B1: recomputed signature UNCHANGED after injecting agentResults. B2: tampered file still signature-VALID. B3: gate ACCEPTS hand-injected reviewer coverage with zero init_check_set calls. C2: erasing a recorded critical issue leaves the file signature-VALID. C3: gate ADVANCES after that erasure. All three controls behaved (A gate control refuses a missing reviewer by name; D1/D2 signature control shows an in-domain title edit IS rejected as init_check_tampered; C1 shows a genuine critical issue does block), so the competing explanation 'the signature check is dead for every field' is ruled out and the defect is field-specific.
records.note: Artifact covers BOTH fields deliberately: a fix that covers only agentResults must leave C2/C3 RED. Scope of the claim is audit integrity, not access control - both outcomes are already reachable via legal CLI calls, so the artifact must never be read as proving reviewer coverage became trustworthy.
